services.description: Ka whakakotahi mātou i te rautaki ihirangi, te hoahoa atanga me te whakatinana hangarau kia kore ai tō pae tukutuku e noho noa i runga ipurangi, engari kia whai hua tūturu.

services.0.description: He pae tukutuku kōpaki mahi, he CV whaiaro rānei hei whakaatu i tō kōtaha, tō wheako me ō mahi ā-ngaio.

services.1.description: He whārangi tau, he kōtaha kamupene rānei ka tere te whakarewa, ka whakapūmau, ā, kua rite hei kukume kiritaki.
services.2.title: Pūnaha mōhiohio me te whakahaere
services.2.description: Ngā papatohu, ngā tomokanga me ngā pūnaha o roto hei whakahaere i ō raraunga me ngā mahi o ia rā o tō pakihi.
services.3.title: Mahi aunoa
services.3.description: Mahia aunoatia ngā mahi tukurua pēnei i ngā whakamōhiotanga, te honohono taputapu, me ngā rere mahi, kia whai wā mō tō tīma.
process.description: He putanga kei ia wāhanga e taea ai e koe te tiro, te whakamātau, me te whakaae. E mōhio tonu ana koe kei hea te mahi e haere ana.
process.0.title: Arotake hiahia
process.0.description: Ka mahere mātou i ngā whāinga pakihi, ngā tohutoro tirohanga, ngā āhuatanga matua me ngā mea tuatahi o te mahi.
process.1.title: Arotake hoahoa
process.1.description: Ka arotakehia, ka whakaaetia ngā anga, te hoahoa me te rere i mua i te whakaputa.
process.2.title: Whanaketanga
process.2.description: Ka hangaia te pae tukutuku, te taupānga, te mahi aunoa rānei, he urutau, i runga i te hoahoa kua whakaaetia.

process.3.description: Ka arotakehia tahitia te putanga, ka whakatikatika mehemea e tika ana, ā, ka whakamātauria kia rite ki te whakarewa.
process.4.title: Whakarewa me te tuku
process.4.description: Ka whakaputaina te hua, ka whakaritea te raraunga tāhuhu me te SEO, ā, ka tukuna atu ki a koe te urunga me te aratohu.
services.0.long: Ko te pae tukutuku kōpaki mahi, CV whaiaro rānei tō kāinga mana i runga i te ipurangi. Ka whakaemihia tō kōtaha, ō wheako me ō mahi ki tētahi whārangi kotahi, māmā noa te tohatoha ki ngā kaituku mahi, ki ngā kiritaki, ki ngā whare wānanga rānei.

services.1.detail.4: Tere te whakarewa ina rite ō rauemi
services.1.for: Ngā pakihi, ngā kura, ngā wharekai, ngā hapori me ngā kamupene e hiahia ana ki te āhua ngaio.
services.2.long: Ka whakaraupapa te pūnaha mōhiohio i ngā mahi e marara ana i ēnei wā ki ngā pukapuka tātai, ngā tuhinga me ngā kōrero. Kotahi te wāhi mō ngā raraunga, ka uru ia tangata mā tōna tūranga, ā, ka taea te tiro i ngā pūrongo i ngā wā katoa.

services.2.detail.4: He wāhi whakahaere hei whakahaere i te ihirangi nāu anō

faq.title: Ngā pātai e puta ana i mua i te tīmatanga.
faq.description: Mehemea kāore anō tāu pātai kia whakautua ki konei, ka taea e te hui whakawhiti kōrero te āwhina ki te tautuhi i ō hiahia.
faq.0.question: He aha ngā ratonga ka taea e Nocoding te hanga?
faq.0.answer: Ka hangaia e mātou ngā pae tukutuku kōpaki mahi, CV whaiaro rānei, ngā whārangi tau, ngā kōtaha kamupene, ngā pūnaha mōhiohio me te whakahaere, me te mahi aunoa mō ngā tukanga pakihi.
faq.1.question: He roa te wā e hangaia ai?
faq.1.answer: Ko te kōpaki mahi, te CV, te whārangi tau māmā rānei he 1-3 rā mahi te roa i muri i te rite o ngā rauemi. Ko ngā kaupapa nui ake ka whakawhirinaki ki ngā āhuatanga e hiahiatia ana, ngā honohono me te tere o ngā whakahoki kōrero.
faq.2.question: Ka taea te whakarite i te hoahoa me ngā āhuatanga?
faq.2.answer: Āe. Ka taea te whakarite i te hoahoa, te anga whārangi, ngā āhuatanga me te rere mahi ki ō hiahia. Ka arotakehia tahitia te hoahoa i mua i te tīmatanga o te hanga.
faq.3.question: He aha kei roto i te utu?
faq.3.answer: Ko te utu e kapi ana i te hanga i runga i te kete me te whānuitanga kua whakaaetia. Kei te Kete Iti te tiaki kore utu me te ingoa rohe mō te 1 tau, ā, kei te Kete Nui te tiaki kore utu me te manaaki tukutuku mō te 1 tau.
contact.title: Kōrerotia mai ngā hiahia mō tō pae tukutuku. Māmā ake te ara mā mātou.
contact.description: Tukuna mai he tirohanga poto o tō pakihi, ngā whārangi e hiahiatia ana me te wā e hiahia ana koe. Kei te whakautu tuatahi ngā tūtohu whānuitanga me ngā mahi e whai ake nei. He kore utu tonu te whakawhiti kōrero, ahakoa āhea koe e hiahia ai.

project.category.ecoswap: Pae tukutuku hokohoko taonga kua whakamahia
project.description.ecoswap: He mākete ā-ipurangi hei hoko, hei hoko atu hoki i ngā taonga kua whakamahia. Ka taea e te tangata te tuku, te tirotiro me te hoko māmā noa mai i te waea, i te rorohiko rānei.
project.description.wiboost: He toa ā-ipurangi mō ngā ratonga matihiko pēnei i te utu whakakī kēmu, ngā kete raraunga me ngā taupānga ūmanga, me ngā toenga a ngā kiritaki me tētahi hōtaka kaihokohoko anō.
project.description.ahawi: He pae tukutuku kōpaki mahi whaiaro i te āhua peita wai, e rua ngā reo, hei whakamōhio i te kōtaha, ngā wheako me ngā taipitopito whakapā.
project.description.abdi: He pūnaha rēhita mō ngā tāngata mahi o te whare rangatira (abdi dalem) o te Keraton o Surakarta: te rēhita, ngā raraunga whaiaro, ngā wā kaupapa, te tae mai me te tā kāri tuakiri.
project.description.sfarm: He taupānga hei whakahaere i tētahi pāmu heihei hoki hua manu me ngā nanenane a te kāinga: ngā rekoata o ia rā, ngā hokonga, ngā whakapaunga me ngā pūrongo pūtea.
project.description.payu: He papa e hono ana i te hunga e tuku mahi ana ki ngā kaimahi motuhake. Ka tuku utu te kaituku mahi, ka oti te mahi i te kaimahi motuhake, ā, ka utua mā QRIS.
project.description.darcasual: He rārangi hua ā-ipurangi neke atu i te mano ngā hua. Ka taea e ngā kaihoko te rapu, te tātari me te tono tika mā WhatsApp.
project.category.ianprem: Toa ā-ipurangi mō ngā taupānga ūmanga
project.description.ianprem: He toa ā-ipurangi mō ngā pūkete taupānga ūmanga pēnei i a Netflix me Spotify. Ka kōwhiri, ka utu ngā kaihoko i a rātou anō, ā, ka whakahaere ngā kaiwhakahaere i te rawa me ngā hokonga.
project.description.alengka: He rārangi ā-ipurangi o ngā taonga whare o roto o waho hoki mō ngā wharekai kawhe, ngā wharekai me ngā kāinga. Ka taea e ngā manuhiri te tirotiro i te kohinga me te kōrero mā WhatsApp.
project.description.sdn: Te pae tukutuku mana o tētahi kura tuatahi me te kōtaha kura, ngā mōhiohio whakaurunga tauira hōu, te rārangi kaiako, ngā mahi ā-kura me ngā angitu a ngā tauira.
project.description.furnix: He rārangi ā-ipurangi o ngā taonga whare rino mai i Jepara mō ngā wharekai kawhe, ngā wharekai me ngā kāinga. Ka taea e ngā manuhiri te kōwhiri hua, te tono hoki i runga i tā rātou e pai ai.
project.description.clothique: He toa kākahu ā-ipurangi tino whai: he rārangi hua, he kāpata hoko, he utu ā-ipurangi, he rangitaki, me tētahi wāhi whakahaere hei whakahaere i ngā tono me ngā pūrongo.
project.description.agli: He taputapu mā ngā tīma ihirangi hei kohikohi i ngā tauira ihirangi i tirohia nuitia, hei kimi i ngā tauira, hei tuhi hoki i ngā tuhinga hōu hei tīmatanga.
project.description.nebulist: He kaiāwhina hokohoko whai AI e hanga ana i tētahi rautaki, ngā tuhinga mō ngā kiritaki pea, me ngā tauira karere whakapā mai i ngā mōhiohio hua.
project.description.carbonfi: He taupānga pūtea matihiko mō te hokohoko i ngā whiwhinga waro (ngā utu whakahoki mō te whakaiti tukunga) me ngā hōtaka utu whakahoki atawhai taiao.
project.description.protectedpay: He taupānga whakawhiti moni matihiko haumaru: ka tukuna noa ngā moni ina tae atu, me ngā utu rōpū me te penapena.
project.description.pedulichain: He papa koha pūataata: ka tuhia mō ake tonu atu ia koha me te whakamahinga o ngā moni, ā, ka kitea e te katoa.
project.description.astra: He kaiāwhina AI ka taea noa te kōrero atu hei whakahaere i ngā rawa matihiko, pēnei i te tuku tohu, i te hanga kohinga matihiko rānei, kāore he mōhio ki te waehere.
project.description.auditfi: He kaitirotiro haumaru e whakamahi ana i te AI mō ngā hōtaka pūtea matihiko e kimi ana i ngā wāhi ngāwari, ā, e tuhi ana i tētahi pūrongo i ngā hēkona.
project.description.p2p: He papa mō te whakawhiti rawa matihiko tika i waenga i ngā kaiwhakamahi, me te tiaki whakawhitinga me tētahi wāhi whakahaere hei whakahaere i te papa.
project.description.payguppy: He taupānga e āwhina ana i ngā toa noa ki te whakaae i ngā utu moni matihiko mā ngā waehere QR kua whai ake ana.
project.description.tiptap: He papa mā ngā kaihanga ihirangi hei whiwhi i ngā koha mai i ō rātou kaimātakitaki ki te moni matihiko, ki ngā kohinga matihiko rānei, me ngā whakamōhiotanga i te wā e tuku ora ana.
project.description.senkus: He kēmu ā-ipurangi whai kaupapa pūtaiao me te whakahurihuri matū: ka whakakotahi ngā kaitākaro i ngā rongoā, ka kohikohi i ngā taonga matihiko, ā, ka whakataetae i tētahi kauhanga.
project.description.quickstock: He taupānga rorohiko hei whakahaere i te rawa o tētahi toa kākahu: te tuhi i ngā hokonga, ngā tukunga a ngā kaiwhakarato me ngā pūrongo rawa, me te urunga i runga i te tūranga o ia kaimahi.
project.description.caer: He papa mō te tuku moni me te tarewa i ngā rawa matihiko puta noa i ngā whatunga me te tautoko i te rupia matihiko IDRX, hei whakamāmā i te penapena me te tarewa.
